findings.detail: Home/Players/Managers threw React #418 for browsers in Asia/Tokyo: server (UTC) and browser (JST) formatted import dates differently; dates were shown in UTC without a zone. Reproduced by time-zone emulation (Tokyo: error, UTC: none).
findings.fix: formatDate/formatDateTime use a fixed Asia/Tokyo zone with a zone name (PR #59); verified locally with a UTC server and on the public site after deploy

findings.detail: The streamed soft-404 carries NEXT_HTTP_ERROR_FALLBACK;404 in the HTML; the not-found title is rendered in the browser. The legacy check now requires the signal or the title (PR #59).
